jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager – Building Services for a major industrial transformation project supporting the transition toward fossil-free steel production in Luleå.
You will lead engineering delivery for critical building services within a large-scale industrial facility, covering HVAC, VVS, potable water, fire protection and Building Management Systems (BMS).
Key Responsibilities:
- Lead engineering activities across large-scale brownfield and greenfield CAPEX projects
- Manage HVAC, heating, ventilation, VVS, water supply, fire protection and BMS integration
- Coordinate technical interfaces and constructability reviews
- Ensure engineering deliverables meet safety, quality and regulatory requirements
- Collaborate with engineering consultants, suppliers, contractors and construction teams
- Drive technical decisions and optimize plant layouts
- Manage engineering schedules, cost forecasts and design-to-cost targets
- Ensure timely delivery of drawings, specifications and commissioning documentation
- Lead engineering teams and promote continuous improvement
Required Experience:
- 10+ years of industry experience, including 5+ years in engineering leadership
- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Sweden
- Proven experience managing large industrial engineering projects
- Strong background in steel, pulp and paper, refinery, oil and gas, or similar industries
- Deep knowledge of HVAC, VVS, potable water, fire protection and BMS integration
- Experience with interface management, constructability and industrial plant design
- Strong engineering cost control, scheduling and stakeholder management skills
- Knowledge of Nordic engineering conditions and standards
- Fluent Swedish and English
Meritorious:
- PMP, IPMA or equivalent project management certification
- Civil engineering background within heavy industrial projects
- Experience with brownfield upgrades and industrial start-up coordination
- Knowledge of Swedish and European building services standards
- Experience with CAD/BIM, plant layouts and industrial engineering documentation
We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on engineering leader who can manage complex industrial interfaces, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and deliver safe, cost-effective engineering solutions.

jobs.description:

At least 8 years of experience in technical project management.

Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Good understanding of system development, integration, and verification.
Fluency in written and spoken English.
Ability to lead structured project execution in complex engineering environments.

Meritorious
Experience with distributed control systems.
Knowledge of embedded and real-time systems.
Experience with Ethernet, EtherCAT, or industrial communication networks.
Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity.
Experience in the energy sector.

The job
Your main tasks will be tractor and machinery operation, including soil preparation, planting, and cultivation. 

Other duties include:
.Moving and handling irrigation equipment
.Daily checks and basic maintenance of machinery
.Transporting vegetables from the fields to cooling and storage facilities
.Loading and unloading produce and equipment

What we are looking for
.Experience operating tractors and agricultural machinery
.A valid driving licence: category T, C, or BE
.Ability to speak and understand English
.Someone who works independently, takes care of equipment, and is willing to help with different tasks

What we offer
.Seasonal employment from April to September 2027

John Rasmus Swang | Farm Manager
holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com

Job Overview
Role Summary
We are seeking a PLC / Automation Engineer for a consulting assignment focused on controller development, HMI solutions, industrial automation, and AGV implementation. The role involves developing PLC-based control systems aligned with project requirements, supporting machine integration, and contributing throughout testing, commissioning, and production start-up activities.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop PLC-based control systems in accordance with project requirements.
Develop, maintain, and improve HMI terminals and operator interfaces.
Participate in system testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project start-up activities.
Manage machine interfaces related to machine procurement and integration.
Program and implement AGV solutions within the automation environment.
Contribute to high-level system architecture, strategic planning, and system design.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and maintain clear technical documentation.
Support testing activities that may occasionally require evening or weekend work.

Technical Stack & Requirements
PLC programming and PLC-based control systems.
HMI design, development, and programming.
SCADA systems.
AGV programming and implementation.
Industrial automation and machine interfaces.
High-level architecture, strategic planning, and system design.
TCP/IP networking.
Experience with vision systems is advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate holds a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Several years of practical experience working with PLC solutions is required, together with experience in HMI design and programming and knowledge of SCADA systems. Candidates should have a solid understanding of TCP/IP networks and be comfortable contributing to architecture and system-design discussions. Experience with vision systems is considered advantageous. Strong English communication skills are required; Swedish language skills are beneficial.

För en svensk företagare bosatt i Göteborg, Sverige, och Nice, Frankrike, söker vi en privat hushållerska. 
Arbetsuppgifterna innebär att sköta en stor bostad i centrala Göteborg och inkluderar:
• Städning
• Tvättning och strykning
• Skötsel av växter
• Vård av möbler
